```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
```

```{r, here-i-am, include = FALSE}
here::i_am("report.Rmd")
```

```{r load-data}
covid_data <- read_csv(
  here("data", "covid_sub.csv")
)
```

# Results

## Coder 1: Pneumonia and Sex

This analysis examines whether pneumonia prevalence differs between male and female patients.

### Table 1: Pneumonia by Sex

```{r coder1-table, eval=params$outcome %in% c("all", "pneumonia")}
table1 <- readRDS(
  here::here("outputs/coder1/table1.rds")
)
```

### Figure 1: Pneumonia by Age Group and Sex

```{r coder1-figure, eval=params$outcome %in% c("all", "pneumonia"), out.width="85%"}
knitr::include_graphics(
  here::here("outputs/coder1/figure1.png")
)
```
